summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement: its consolidated VIE, Jiangxi Ruanyun Technology Co., Ltd., as supplier, contracted with Jiangxi Zhongtong Information Industry Data Services Co., Ltd. to deliver and deploy the YeeZo platform and related systems across ten AIGC vocational training laboratories. The contract value is RMB5,992,185.94 (~$0.88 million), with delivery, installation, and acceptance due by September 25, 2026. This is an ordinary commercial procurement/supply contract, not a special situation. No governance, capital structure, or ownership changes are involved. Watch for revenue recognition in future results.
